expected_disbursement_date null can break processors parsing epoch long — set aligned epoch ms

BATCH APIs need op_code + job_time in request; align JOB_TIME to EOD business date epoch ms

QA4 ref 6011424638: dfd.outstanding_loan_balance==UNBLD_PRIN (10202); EXCESS_* GL (52) is claim-overpay legs NOT added into OS. Local S9 OS==UNBLD+EXCESS can pass coincidentally when harness OS was future_prin covering both — do not treat OS==UNBLD+EXCESS as universal. Prefer fail-closed OS>=UNBLD and OS==staging; compare OS==UNBLD as QA4 SoT.
